headline.en: UNI trades 21% above DAO burn anchor while net inflation persists at +2% annually; liquidity death confirmed by 0.2% daily turnover.
headline.zh: UNI 价格较 DAO 回购成本溢价 21%，但年化净通胀率仍达 +2%；日成交量仅占市值 0.2%，流动性枯竭确认。

keyChanges.en: Net inflation remains at +2.01%/year: only 2.14M UNI burned vs 20M emitted, covering just 10.7% of emissions despite burn narrative.
keyChanges.zh: 年化净通胀率维持在 +2.01%：仅销毁 214 万 UNI，相对 2000 万年度增发仅覆盖 10.7%，回购叙事失效。

keyChanges.en: Price premium to treasury burn anchor expanded to +21% ($7.22 vs $5.96 DAO cost basis), suggesting compression risk ahead.
keyChanges.zh: 价格较国库回购成本基准溢价扩大至 +21%（$7.22 vs DAO 成本 $5.96），暗示回调压力。

keyChanges.en: 24h volume collapsed to $9.38M (0.2% of mcap turnover), signaling liquidity crisis and zero conviction from traders.
keyChanges.zh: 24 小时成交量暴跌至 938 万美元（市值换手率仅 0.2%），显示流动性危机与交易者信心缺失。

contrarianObservation.en: Arc protocol fee expansion proposal could increase annualized revenue 30-50% within two quarters; at $150M revenue, buybacks would cover 50% of emissions at current price, materially improving the inflation dynamic before any real-yield vote.
contrarianObservation.zh: Arc 协议手续费扩展提案可能在两季度内使年化收入增长 30-50%；若收入达 1.5 亿美元，当前价格下回购可覆盖 50% 增发，在真实收益投票前即可实质改善通胀动态。

watchNext.en: Arc fee expansion temp check vote outcome — passage could add $30-45M to annual revenue run-rate.
watchNext.zh: Arc 手续费扩展温度检查投票结果 —— 通过可能为年化收入增加 3000-4500 万美元。

watchNext.en: Protocol revenue crossing $150M annualized threshold — would reduce net inflation to ~1% and shift narrative.
watchNext.zh: 协议年化收入突破 1.5 亿美元阈值 —— 将使净通胀率降至约 1%，改变市场叙事。

watchNext.en: Real-yield RFC emergence in governance forums — serious discussion would trigger 20-30% reflexive bounce.
watchNext.zh: 真实收益 RFC 在治理论坛出现 —— 严肃讨论将引发 20-30% 反身性反弹。

fullReasoning.en: UNI is trapped in a structural bear case. Price sits 21% above the DAO's own burn-cost anchor of $5.96, yet the token remains net inflationary at +2.01% annually. With only 2.14M UNI burned against 20M emitted, buybacks cover just 10.7% of emissions. At current protocol revenue of $91M/year and 17% fee capture, the buyback budget is $15.5M — nowhere near sufficient. Break-even requires either $849M annual revenue or price falling to $3.86. The volume signal confirms weakness: $9.38M daily turnover on $4.51B market cap is 0.2%, indicating complete absence of conviction. This isn't compression; it's liquidity death. The 7-day -6.46% trend confirms directional weakness, while 0.00% funding shows no aggressive positioning either way — the market simply doesn't care. Governance reveals no urgency on the real-yield pivot that would reframe UNI as a cash-flow asset. Forums discuss technical features (v4 hooks, privacy) instead of the economic transformation traders await. Without that catalyst, UNI remains in valuation limbo: neither a governance token (turnout is negligible) nor a yield asset (no distributions). With BTC dominance at 60%, capital continues rotating out of DeFi alts. The premium to treasury burn cost suggests either optimistic revenue projections being priced in or a compression trade waiting to happen. Given the emission math, compression toward $5.80-6.50 over 3-4 weeks seems more probable than expansion. The bear case only breaks if Arc expansion meaningfully accelerates revenue or real-yield discussion gains momentum.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 陷入结构性困境。价格较 DAO 回购成本基准 $5.96 溢价 21%，但代币年化净通胀率仍达 +2.01%。仅销毁 214 万 UNI，相对 2000 万年度增发，回购仅覆盖 10.7%。当前协议年化收入 9097 万美元，17% 手续费分成下回购预算仅 1547 万美元，远远不足。达到收支平衡需协议收入 8.49 亿美元或价格跌至 $3.86。成交量信号确认疲软：938 万美元日成交对应 45.1 亿美元市值，换手率仅 0.2%，显示信心完全缺失。这不是波动率压缩，而是流动性枯竭。7 日跌幅 -6.46% 确认方向性弱势，而 0.00% 资金费率显示双方均未激进建仓 —— 市场根本不关注。治理层面未见真实收益转型紧迫性，论坛讨论集中在技术细节（v4 hooks、隐私功能）而非交易者等待的经济模式转型。缺乏该催化剂，UNI 持续处于估值真空：既非治理代币（投票率极低）也非收益资产（无分红）。BTC 主导率达 60%，资金持续流出 DeFi 山寨币。价格相对国库成本溢价暗示市场要么在定价乐观收入预期，要么是等待发生的回调交易。考虑增发数学，未来 3-4 周回调至 $5.80-6.50 区间概率更高。唯有 Arc 扩展实质性提升收入或真实收益讨论获得动能，空头逻辑方可打破。
